create_SO2_exp: create a 2D rotation using So2.exp(theta) to build a rotation from an angle
create_SO2_matrix: create the 2x2 rotation matrix representation from an So2 instance using the matrix method
test_SO2_exp_log: test that So2.exp then So2.log round-trips back to the original theta value
refactor_SO2_mul: refactor the So2 multiplication operator to support rotation concatenation or point transformation
summarize_SO2_derivatives: summarize the So2 derivative methods including calc_Dx_exp_x and Dx_exp_x_matrix_at_0
